无期迷途瑟琳黑石英饰品（可跟随打架）
去老鼠帽子店购买。
更改颜色请前往铁匠铺使用 50个金锭（Gold Bar） 购买Trinket Colorizer（饰品染色机），购买后使用 15个万象晶球（Omni Geode）进行染色。存在一些等级上的bug但是我懒得改了似乎不影响使用。

理论上未来可能跟进更多皮肤。

Pathtonowhere-ShalomShalomSchorl Trinket (Combat Companion)

Available for purchase at the Hat Mouse shop.

To change its color, head to the Blacksmith and buy the Trinket Colorizer for 50 Gold Bars. After obtaining it, use 15 Omni Geodes to recolor the trinket.

There are minor level-related bugs, which do not affect normal gameplay so I won’t fix them for now.

More custom skins may be added in future updates.
